title: why i avoid ai cold calling
description:
AI cold calling can cost $500 to $1,000 per illegal call.
I avoid AI voice because the law can fine me for each call.
I explain why I never use automated AI calls or texts. You must check your state rules and your website terms. If you dial numbers on a Do Not Call list you can be fined $500 to $1,000 each time. The same risk applies to AI SMS.

#AI #ColdCalling #Compliance #Business
